title: Inside-JEPA: From Prediction to Relational Grounding in Latent World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.31194v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn world models in latent space, enabling efficient planning but leaving their states opaque. We introduce Inside-JEPA, which places relational channels for ordered entity pairs inside the JEPA latent state and shows that an inverse-dynamics loss can ground these channels without relation labels when its head reads them, either alone or as part of the full state. On Something-Something V2, latent prediction alone performs no better than a random relation head, while inverse-dynamics supervision that recovers actions from channel changes improves relational AUROC by .065-.103 across ten settings with annotated boxes, by .081 on RH20T robot episodes with held-out tasks, and by .050-.061 across five relations using off-the-shelf detection and tracking. An inverse head on entity latents decodes actions more accurately but barely improves relational grounding; shuffled labels, two label-free

translated_title: Inside-JEPA：潜在世界模型中从预测走向关系接地
translated_abstract: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）在潜在空间中学习世界模型，能够实现高效规划，但其状态却是不透明的。我们提出Inside-JEPA，它将有序实体对的关系通道置于JEPA潜在状态内部，并证明当逆动力学损失的头读取这些通道时——无论是单独读取还是作为完整状态的一部分读取——无需关系标签即可使这些通道实现接地。在Something-Something V2数据集上，仅靠潜在预测的效果并不比随机关系头更好，而通过从通道变化中恢复动作的逆动力学监督，在十个带标注框的设置中将关系AUROC提升了0.065-0.103，在RH20T机器人片段（含留出任务）上提升了0.081，在使用现成检测与跟踪方法的五类关系上提升了0.050-0.061。基于实体潜在表示的逆动力学头虽然能更准确地解码动作，但几乎不能改善关系接地；打乱标签、两种无标签（
tldr: Inside-JEPA将有序实体对的关系通道嵌入JEPA潜在状态内部，并利用逆动力学损失在无需关系标签的情况下实现关系接地，在多个数据集上显著提升了关系预测性能。
en_tdlr: Inside-JEPA places relational channels for ordered entity pairs inside JEPA latent states and shows that an inverse-dynamics loss can ground these channels without relation labels, substantially improving relational prediction across vision and robot benchmarks.
